open_issues.description: ALL 8 mid-session limit entries across S2-S4 filled at/around the 5-minute stale-cancel window (S2: PLTR, XLE; S3: RIVN, TSLA, IWM; S4: AAPL, IWM, RIVN — 8-for-8, fully systematic). Root cause: broker cancels are asynchronous — a 2xx response means the cancel REQUEST was accepted, not that the order is cancelled — but FillTracker trusted the success response and dropped the order, leaving the filled position unmanaged until the next reconciler pass (10-15 min blind window). Escalating impact: S3 IWM peak-tracking started late; S4 AAPL lost ~48% of a $188 premium during the blind window (-$91, largest Phase 3 loss).
open_issues.resolution: Fix 12 (2026-07-16): FillTracker now confirms the order's actual terminal state via get_order_status after EVERY cancel attempt (success and 422/error paths). FILLED/PARTIALLY_FILLED routes to the fill handler immediately — position opens same cycle, no blind window. Non-terminal status defers to the next poll instead of assuming dead. Chosen over extending entry_order_timeout_secs because it is a pure state-sync defect fix (no threshold/parameter change, no frozen-hash file touched) and eliminates the blind window at any timeout value, whereas a longer timeout only shifts the race. Regression tests added (test_successful_cancel_but_filled_routes_to_fill_handler, test_cancel_in_flight_defers_to_next_poll); existing stale-cancel mocks updated to realistic async-cancel semantics.

_shadow_book_note.revised: 2026-07-20 (episode dedup + fill validation + corrected bias statement)
_shadow_book_note.type: observability only — no trading behavior change
_shadow_book_note.description: Shadow book (app/evaluation/shadow_book.py, wired into session_runner). Logs every fully qualified ORB/VWAP signal including those blocked by capacity constraints (max_trades_per_day, orb_slot_reserved, position_already_open, pending_order_exists, cooldown_after_loss, recon_blocked) to evaluation/shadow_book.jsonl, and simulates capacity-blocked signals under the live exit rules marked to the option bid each cycle. Purpose: measure whether trade-slot competition starves vwap_reclaim of samples (Q1 support). Analysis via scripts/shadow_report.py.
_shadow_book_note.episode_dedup: Repeated observations of the same (strategy, underlying, direction) within a 60-min episode window are ONE unique opportunity; only the first observation can open a shadow position. Report shows raw signals AND unique opportunities; opportunities are the denominator.
_shadow_book_note.fill_validation: Two shadow categories. theoretical = order would have been submitted (all shadow entries). fill_validated = quote ask touched the buy limit within a 10-min fill window of entry (or was marketable at entry). Fill-validated results are the PRIMARY counterfactual; theoretical results are sensitivity analysis only.
_shadow_book_note.model_bias: NET BIAS IS MIXED — do not read shadow P&L as a bound. Entry at submitted limit without price improvement: conservative on price. Assuming the limit fills: optimistic on fill probability (fill validation mitigates, does not eliminate — a touched ask does not guarantee queue-position fill). Exit at trigger without slippage: optimistic. Marking to bid: conservative on valuation.
_shadow_book_note.interpretation_rule: Shadow trades inform strategy design and capacity decisions ONLY. They never count toward the live-readiness paper-trading sample. Broker-executed trades remain primary evidence (real order behavior, fill uncertainty, timing, state management).
_shadow_book_note.baseline_plan: Keep current configuration (max_trades_per_day=3, ORB slot reservation) UNCHANGED until at least 5 additional sessions AND at least 10 unique capacity-blocked opportunities are recorded. Then evaluate: (1) how many VWAP opportunities were blocked; (2) which mechanism blocked them; (3) how many were realistically fillable (fill-validated); (4) their expectancy; (5) whether repeated signals were distinct trades or the same setup (episode data); (6) whether executing them would have violated concurrency/correlation limits.
_shadow_book_note.conditional_next_cohort: IF shadow data confirms qualified, fillable VWAP trades are repeatedly displaced by ORB, next cohort config: max 6 trades/day, max 3 per strategy, max 2 concurrent positions, 1 contract per trade, 1 position per underlying, and NO preference/reservation giving ORB priority over VWAP — a fair head-to-head experiment. This is a declared future amendment, NOT active.
